Commentary.Commentary: A mammoth batting performance from the Proteas. It was set up by superlative tons from Duminy and Elgar. The duo's efforts blunted Australia to a large extent and then de Kock along with the lower order hammered home the advantage to give the tourists a mammoth lead. Australia need a hugely improbable target of 539 to win this game. The largest ever successful chase is only 418 and even the highest fourth innings total is 529 which shows the enormity of the task. Don't go anywhere as the chase isn't far away.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the fourth day's play. Centuries from Duminy and Elgar helped the visitors wrest the initiative completely from Australia yesterday. With the lead inching towards the 400-run mark, the hosts definitely have their task cut out. Let's see how many more SA can add this morning. Stay tuned as the action isn't far away.
.....DAY 4, SESSION 1.....

The lead is 388 and Australia have a mountain to climb from here. They'll have to bat out their skins to stay alive in this game. How many more will South Africa add to their tally? They probably have enough already although the history between the two sides at this ground suggests otherwise. It should be another thrilling day's play tomorrow. Tune in at 0800 IST for the fourth day's play. Till then, it's goodbye from us.

Mitchell Marsh was the only Australian bowler to operate with discipline. The specialist pace trio of Starc, Siddle and Hazlewood was too inconsistent to create constant pressure on the visiting batsmen. Lyon was underbowled which was another debatable call, considering that the off spinner had created a chance during the mammoth stand. Overall, definitely a disappointing day for the hosts.

South Africa's day without any doubt. Duminy and Elgar extended their overnight partnership to a mammoth 250 runs before the former departed just at the stroke of tea. The duo's contrasting centuries drove home the advantage for the Proteas. The visitors did lose a few wickets late in the day but de Kock and Philander ensured that Australia couldn't build on that momentum.

FOUR! Edged but safe! Back of a length delivery outside off, Faf is a bit squared up as he looks to poke at it. An outside edge is induced which flies through gully for a boundary.
Yorker outside off, it's jammed out well. du Plessis is searching where the ball is.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Faf du Plessis swivels and rolls it wrists to get it through square leg for a couple.
Too full and in the channel on off, Protea skipper leaves it alone.
FOUR! Good length delivery on off, du Plessis looks to drive but gets it off the outer part of the bat through covers for a boundary.
Wide outside off and Faf has got nothing do with that one.
Banged in short on middle and leg, Bavuma ducks under the bumper.
Fuller around off, Bavuma gets on the front foot and blocks it out.
Whoa, that made him hop around! Short of a length around off, climbs on Bavuma as he looks to fend at it. The ball lobs up off the glove but falls safe.
FOUR! Bavuma is off the mark! Short and outside off, he sees the width and flashes the cut. Doesn't bother keeping it down and gets it wide of the point fielder to find the fence.
Fuller around off, tails in as Bavuma jams it back to the bowler.
Full on middle and leg, Bavuma works it to the leg side.
Good length angled in from outside off, another leave from Faf.
Full but once again sprayed way outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Back of a length way outside off, Faf will leave those all day.
That's better from the pacer! Length ball angled in from outside off, holds its line after pitching as Faf pokes at it. He's lucky not to get an edge.

FOUR! Finds the fence! Overcompensates by going too straight and full on middle stump, Faf shuffles and glances it nicely down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Starc continues to struggle with his radar.
Back of a length very wide outside off, left alone to the keeper.

Close shave! Good length around off, tails in sharply as Bavuma doesn't offer a stroke. The ball just goes over the top of off pole. Very brave leave in hindsight but I don't think he should be trying that again.
Good length outside off, Bavuma hangs back and defends it well.
Full and around off, Bavuma drives but gets it off the inside half past the two short mid-wicket fielders.
Keeps it well outside off, Bavuma makes a leave to that one.
Fuller and around off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
Shaun Marsh comes in at short leg.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Length ball sprayed way outside off, doesn't interest Faf at all.
Good length angled in from around off, Faf lifts his bat to make the leave.
Good length outside off, yet another leave from the SA skipper.
Full and this time closer to off, still not that probing to make Faf play.
Length ball but too wide outside off, easy leave for du Plessis.
Mitchell Starc is back on.
Good length just outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Full and just outside off, Bavuma lets it pass through to the keeper.
Full and tails in a touch from around off, Bavuma blocks it from the crease.
Temba Bavuma walks in next, replacing Elgar!

OUT! Hazlewood strikes! How often have you seen a wicket falling after the break? Full ball and angling in from outside off, Elgar drives away from his body without moving his feet. Gets a thick edge that flies straight to Starc who gobbles it up at gully. Ends a really gritty knock from the opener although he did look scratchy for a major part of the innings. Lead is now 322.
Full and well outside off, Elgar doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Length ball angled in from outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
A touch short and outside off, Faf gets back and punches it through the covers for a brace. Time for Drinks as well!
Flighted on middle stump, Faf looks to flick it as the ball lobs up in the air past short leg. Some excitement but probably off the pads.
Flatter outside off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
Flighted outside off, blocked solidly from the crease on to the track.
Slider on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side. Single taken.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked past Shaun Marsh who goes to his left from short leg. Prevents the single.
Nathan Lyon is back on.
Good length closer to off, tight line and Faf doesn't play at it.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Full and around off, driven off the front foot towards mid off.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length outside off, a bit of shape away, du Plessis leaves it alone.
FOUR! Gets it through! A bit short and outside off, width on offer and Faf pounces on it with a square cut through backward point to find the fence.
Good length angled in from outside off, Elgar looks to play a back foot punch but is beaten.
Full and on off, Faf drives it dead straight past the bowler. Siddle at mid off goes across to his right to make a sliding stop. He can't stop the single though.
Good length around off, Faf gets back and pushes it to silly mid on.
Very full and around off, du Plessis squeezes it out towards mid off.
Length ball outside off, shaping away a bit as Faf lets it pass.
Fuller on middle, Faf gets across and jams it to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Clipped away! Length ball down the leg side, Elgar gets across and glances it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Poor ball to finish the over and Hazlewood is upset with himself.
Good length around off, Elgar stays back to push at it but gets the edge towards Starc at gully.
Length ball outside off, nips in sharply as Faf pushes at it. The ball flies off the inside half past a diving short mid-wicket. The man at mid on goes to his right and stops it. Single taken.
Shortens the length a bit around off, Faf stays back and blocks it solidly.
Length ball just outside off, Faf hangs back and lets it pass.
Good length outside off, defended well off the front foot to the covers.
Josh Hazlewood is back on.
Good length angled in from around off, squared up Elgar totally as he looked to poke at it but missed.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball well outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Shortish outside off, Elgar camps back and taps it towards point.
Length ball from outside off, tails in sharply as Elgar makes a good leave.
Full and outside off, Faf drives it towards mid off for a single.
Good length around off, Elgar defends it well from the crease.

FOUR! Great shot! Elgar continues to dig in despite the cramps. Full ball on off, he gets across and drives it elegantly past mid on to find the fence. There have been so many spectacular drives down the ground in the game especially from SA.
Length ball around leg stump, Elgar looks to flick but the ball lobs up for a while. Lands safe but it came off the pad anyway.
Full and around off, Elgar pushes it firmly to silly mid off.
Good length on middle and leg, worked away down to fine leg for a single.
Full and tailing in from around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Pitched up outside off, pushed off the front foot towards mid off.
Fullish ball around off, Elgar looks to drive but gets it off the inside half towards mid on.

FOUR! Edge goes through! Length ball angled in from outside off, Elgar pushes at it with soft hands. Gets the edge but it falls well short and goes past Smith at first slip to the third man fence. The fact that he didn't push hard at it saved him in the end.
Pitched up well outside off, Elgar reaches out and drives it well to cover.
Fullish and closer to off, defended well off the front foot down the pitch.
Full and around off, Elgar gets across and pushes it to mid on.
Pitched up outside off, Faf gets on the front foot and defends it solidly to cover.
Full and just outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length around off, nips in a touch as Faf blocks well off the back foot.
Good length angled in around off, Faf stays back and blocks it out.
Full and angled in on off, driven firmly to silly mid on where the fielder gets a hand to parry it to mid on.
Fuller outside off, Faf plays a crunchy drive towards mid off.
Full and outside off, Elgar drives it towards mid off.
Pitched up outside off, Elgar stays in the crease and jams it to the off side.
Full and outside off, Elgar digs it out to the covers.
Good length angled in from around off, Elgar stays in the crease and taps it to short cover.
Looks to go very full but ends up dishing a low full toss way outside off, no shot offered.
Full and angled in on middle, nips in a touch to rap Elgar on the front pad. Stifled lbw appeal but that did too much off the deck.
Length ball around off, Faf gets across and defends it well.
Almost a nick! Full ball outside off, a hint of shape as Faf looks to drive without moving his feet. He is very lucky not to get an edge there.
Full and outside off, Faf gets on the front foot and blocks it out.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Full and outside off, Faf gets on the front foot and blocks it.
Fuller on leg stump, dug out towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! What a shot to get off the mark! Full ball on middle stump line, Faf gets across and drives it sweetly past mid on. Beautifully timed and that races away to the fence. The SA skipper is away in style.
Pitched up outside off, Elgar bunts it towards extra cover. The fielder at mid off goes to his right to make a good stop. Single taken.
Fullish on off, defends it well off the front foot down the track.
Keeps it full and just outside off, nice lines from Marsh to begin with. Left alone to the keeper.
Full and angling away wider outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length on off, Elgar hangs back and blocks it on to the pitch.
Mitchell Marsh to bowl from the other end.
Good length outside off, Faf stays back and defends it.
Full and outside off, blocked well off the front foot.

Peach to begin after tea! Length ball outside off, extra bounce and away movement as Faf pushes tentatively at it. The ball whizzed past the outside edge. Siddle almost as an afterthought appeals but it looked nothing more than comical.

Welcome back for the final session of the day. South Africa firmly in the driver's seat and will look to continue piling on the runs. Australia will hope to build on the wicket they have just got before the break. Faf du Plessis is the new man in and he joins Dean Elgar in the middle. Siddle to finish this over.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 3.....

Australia's bowlers were marginally better after lunch but the issue with consistency continued as they started getting frustrated with every run added by the Duminy-Elgar stand. It didn't help their cause either that they couldn't take the chance offered by Elgar. Starc looked below par and that has hurt the hosts, considering how much they depend on him. Can the home side mount some sort of a comeback and restrict SA within 350-375 or will the Protea juggernaut roll on? Join us in a while for the final session.

Another superb session for South Africa despite losing a wicket at the stroke of tea. Duminy and Elgar continued to dominate the Aussie bowling with both batsmen getting past the three-figure mark. The latter offered a chance that was misjudged by Starc but apart from that, both looked supremely confident as they tore into the hosts' bowling attack. Just when it seemed like that they would go into the break without being separated, Duminy feathered one through to Nevill.

OUT! The decision is overturned and Australia are all smiles. They needed it, they desperately needed it. Peter Siddle has provided a much, much-needed breakthrough. Coming to the ball, he hurls it nice and full outside off, since this was the last over before tea, Duminy could have easily let it go. But that wasn't meant to be. He fiddles with it and it goes through to to the keeper. An appeal is made but the umpire stays unmoved. Smith takes the review. There was surely some noise but Hot Spot shows nothing. Snicko confirms there was an edge and that is it. End of a massive 250-run stand and Jean Paul Duminy walks back but not before playing a splendid knock. TEA ON DAY 3!

A loud appeal for a caught behind and umpire Aleem Dar stays unmoved. Smith opts for the review straightaway. There was surely some noise as it went to the keeper. Will Australia cherish something before heading into the break?
Fuller in length and outside off, driven straight to Warner at mid off who moves across to his left quickly and fires a throw at the striker's end.
Good length delivery on middle, Duminy covers the line and defends it down.
Last over before Tea coming up...
Loopy ball around off, Elgar keeps it out watchfully.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards long off for a single. 250-run stand is up as well.
Flighted ball around middle and off, Duminy prods forward and defends it.
Comes down the track and defends it on the off side. Lyon for some reason appeals for it, a desperate one?
Loopy ball around off, JP defends it solidly.
Floated ball around middle, Duminy stays back and defends it back to Lyon.
Fuller in length on off, Elgar drives it straight to the man at silly mid off.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
On a length and outside off, defended with a straight bat.
Fuller in length and hurled outside off, Elgar comes forward and shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller in length and angling in, worked towards short mid-wicket.
In the channel outside off, the batsman lifts his bat and allows it to go through to the keeper.
Flighted on a length outside off, JP hangs back and defends it out.
Quicker ball on middle and leg, tucked behind square for a single.
Sliding in from outside off, blocked well off the back foot to the off side.
Tossed up around off, Elgar presses forward and defends it with a straight bat.
Drifting in fuller on middle, jammed towards the leg side.
Full toss outside off, slapped down the ground to long off for one.
Fuller on off, Elgar bunts it towards mid off.
Angles away on a length and outside off. Elgar opens the face of the bat at the last moment and defends it towards gully.
Fuller in length on off, Elgar defends it solidly back to the bowler.
On a length and outside off, DE hangs back in defense.
A silly mid off in place now...

FOUR! Oozing class, Dean! A high quality shot, just wow! Fuller in length and on the stumps, Elgar leans into it, shows full face of the bat and creams it down the ground past the bowler for a boundary. No need to run for those.
On a good length and outside off, Elgar defends it towards covers.
Peter Siddle is back on for a spell. Can he provide a breakthrough just before the break?
Flatter through the air around middle, Duminy defends it with a straight bat.
Floated ball around off, JP defends it down watchfully.
Gets forward and keeps it out gently.
Full and around middle, worked through the leg side for a single.

Shouts of CATCH IT from our cubicle! Tosses this one around off, Elgar gets down on one knee to sweep. It's uppish but there is no one in the deep mid-wicket region. The ball slows down and they take two.
Loopy ball around off, driven straight to covers.
Dean Elgar is getting some treatment out there. Looks like there are cramps on his right hand. The conditions are too hot as well.
Fuller on the pads, nudged through mid-wicket for a brace.
Lets out a bumper down the leg side, JP ducks to evade it.
Length ball on the pads, Elgar wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.
What was that? Hazlewood digs it short on middle, Duminy who initially looks to duck but then at the last moment switches for the pull shot towards backward square leg for a single.
Good length ball on middle, defended with a straight bat.
On a length and outside off, Duminy shoulders his arms to that one.
Loopy delivery around middle and off, Elgar prods forward and keeps it out.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up delivery around off, Elgar camps back and punches it towards the off side.
Short and flat on off, punched towards covers.
Loopy ball around off, Elgar comes forward to play at it but gets beaten.
5th Test ton for Dean Elgar!

FOUR! Lovely shot! Brings up the 100 in style. He is absolutely delighted and boy, this has been truly a splendid knock. Tossed up around off, Elgar gets forward and creams it through covers for a boundary. South Africa running away with the game now.
Nathan Lyon is back into the attack!
Australia isn't happy at all. The ball is not going through that 8-shape gauge and Nigel Llong is calling for a new one.
Banged in short on leg, JP ducks to let that one sail over him to the keeper.
Gets behind the line and taps it on the off side.
Some issue with the ball again. The umpires are having a look at it. The 8-shape gauge is out again.
Fuller in length on off, Duminy drives it straight to mid off.
Length delivery outside off, Duminy defends it down gently.
Good length ball on middle, Jp tucks it towards short mid-wicket.

FOUR! Cut away! Short of a length ball, width on offer too. Duminy stays put and cuts it through point for a boundary towards third man. Nice way to start the over. This is his 20th boundary already, looks so solid out there.

FOUR! Squeezed through point! Dean Elgar moves on to 99 now! Very full outside off, the southpaw slices it beautifully through point and gully. Mitchell Marsh and Lyon goes for the chase but to no avail. Just one short of a deserving ton here.
Fuller in length and around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Good length ball outside off, Elgar opens the face of the bat and dabs it towards gully.
Short of a length ball outside off, left alone by Dean.

Fuller and coming back in sharply as Elgar misses the flick and is hit on the pads. A muted appeal by Starc but nothing from the umpire. Going down leg. Replays even show there was a slight inside edge as well.
On a length and shaping away a touch. JP pushes it from the crease towards covers for one.
Outside off, Elgar has got nothing to do with that one.
Banged in short on off, Elgar ducks to evade it.
Fuller in length on off, pushed towards David Warner at mid off.
Fullish in length and outside off, defended solidly.
Good length delivery on off, Dean defends it down gently.
Fuller in length and outside off, Elgar comes forward and blocks it well.
Low full toss, tailing in as well. JP drives it towards mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Lovely shot and brilliant piece of fielding as well! Very full on off, Elgar gets forward and drives it past mid off. Warner gives it a chase and does well to put in a dive and scoop the ball back.
Short of a length ball on off, Elgar goes for the pull but the ball bounces off the deck and he gets beaten. Little bit nervy he seems as he is inching closer to a ton here.
Landed outside off, cut through point for a single.
On a length and served outside off, Duminy is solid in his defense.
Short of a length ball on middle, pulled straight to the man at short mid-wicket.
Gets behind the line and defends it down to the off side.

Short of a length ball on middle, Duminy looks to duck but the bounce gets bigger on him as the ball goes off the back portion of the bat and lobs up towards fine leg. In the air but no damage done. One run is taken.
Good length on off, defended down gently.

Touch short and outside off, Duminy stays put and chops it past slips towards third man. Voges and Smith goes for the chase. The former puts in a dive and scoops the ball back to the skipper. Two runs taken.
Comes from around the wicket and hurls it on a length on off. Duminy punches it on the up through covers. Warner gives it a chase and keeps them down to a brace.
Very full and around off, Elgar just about digs it out.
Back of a length on middle and leg, tucked from the crease to mid-wicket.
Full and just outside off, Elgar lifts his bat to make the leave.
Length ball angled in closer to off, Elgar gets back and defends it well.
Good length outside off, driven on the up through the covers. Protection in the deep now and so just a single.
Length ball curving into the pads, JP works it through square leg for a brace.
Mitchell Starc is back on.
Strange! Just one over with the second new ball and the umpires are looking at its shape with the 8-shape gauge. Seems fine. Not sure what it was about in the first place.
Full and just outside off, no shot offered to that one.
FOUR! High quality shot! Length ball outside off, width on offer and Elgar drives it sweetly through extra cover to find the fence. That sped away to the fence in no time. Gets into the 90s.
FOUR! Poor ball and put away! Length ball on the pads, Elgar gets across and clips it delicately down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. He was quick to pounce on the offering.
Almost carried! Fullish on middle stump, Elgar plays across the line but gets outside edge which just falls short of Mitchell Marsh at gully.
Good length around off, blocked well from the crease to the covers.
Fuller on middle and leg, JP shuffles across and wrists it through mid-wicket. Siddle gives a long chase and just pulls the ball back into play. Three more to the total.
The second new ball is now available and Australia have taken it straightaway. Josh Hazlewood to start off proceedings with the fresh cherry.
Tossed up outside off, Elgar reaches out and defends it solidly.
Fuller outside off, blocked off the front foot.
Flighted outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Fullish on middle, gets across and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter around off, Elgar gets across and blocks it out.
Loopy and outside off, Elgar doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Loopy outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
FOUR! Steered away! No stopping JP! Flatter ball and a touch short, he stays back and opens the bat face to steer it to the third man fence for a boundary. 200-run stand comes up.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker ball outside off, JP presses forward and smothers it.
Fuller on middle and off, Duminy bunts it towards mid on for a single.
Fuller outside off, JP pushes it to cover.
Floated outside off, pushed towards the covers.
Full toss but JP can't put it away. Slams it down to long on for a single.
Drifting in fuller on off, JP pats it back to the bowler.
Fuller on middle, Elgar works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted outside off, pushed off the front foot to point.
Floated well outside off, skids off the deck with bounce as Elgar is beaten.
Adam Voges comes into the attack.

SIX! Shot! This is rubbing salt into the wounds. Drifting in from outside off, JP steps out and shows his partner how it's done. Launches an inside out lofted stroke over the covers for a big maximum.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.

Chance goes down! Starc misjudged it totally and the expression on Smith's face tells it all. Tossed up ball around off, Elgar steps out and looks to hoick it across the line but miscues it high to mid off. Starc circles around the region and sights the ball late but loses his balance a touch. He stretches his left hand in despair but the ball falls well short. Probably lost it in the sun. Single taken meanwhile. Australia cannot afford to miss chances like these.
Drifting away outside off, Duminy reaches out and taps it to point for a single.
Tossed up around off, Duminy presses forward and defends it to the covers.
Floated on middle stump, JP presses forward and defends it well.
A hammer comes in to level the landing area for the bowlers.
Length ball outside off, pushed off the front foot to the off side. Single taken.
Shortish outside off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
Good length outside off, defended well off the back foot to the off side.

FOUR! Squeezed it away! Very full around leg stump, JP looks to dig it out as the ball goes down the leg side to the fine leg fence. Stifled appeal for lbw but turned down. No signal from the umpire so that must have been bat. Replays show that it was a thick inside edge that went between the legs.
Banged in short around off, Duminy evades the bumper.
Wide! Short ball but too high as JP ducks. Too high and wide called.
Full and around off, driven off the front foot towards cover.
Fuller outside off, Elgar gets well forward and defends it.
Tossed up outside off, pushed off the front foot towards wide mid off.
FOUR! Hammered! Drifting in from around off, Elgar steps out to that one and smacks it straight back past the bowler down the ground to the long off fence for a boundary.
Slider outside off, Elgar defends it well from the crease.
Floated outside off, JP steps out and pushes it to the off side for a single.
Flatter outside off, blocked off the front foot to the covers.
Full and outside off, Elgar reaches out and defends it out.
Full and outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Length ball on leg stump, Duminy misses the flick but the ball rolls off the pads to the leg side. A leg bye added.
5th Test ton for Duminy, 3rd against Australia.
Full and outside off, Duminy leans into it and drives it through the covers for a brace. Take a bow, son! This knock has been nothing short of exceptional.
Good length angled in from well outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller outside off, Elgar eases it firmly towards extra cover. Warner from mid off runs across to right and makes a superb diving stop. Single taken.
Floated outside off, Elgar leans into it and defends it to cover.
Drifting in on leg stump, Elgar works it through backward square leg for a single.
A bit short outside off, Elgar stays back and chops it to the off side.
Fuller on middle and off, Elgar drives it back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, Elgar pushes at it but gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Floated outside off, Elgar steers it towards point.
Good length on leg stump, worked through fine leg for a single.
Full and outside off, Duminy drives it towards extra cover for a single.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Full and outside off, JP doesn't offer a stroke to that one.
Another length ball outside off, Duminy doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Short of a length very wide outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Mitchell Marsh comes on to bowl.
Floated on a length outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Flatter on a length outside off, chopped off the back foot to the off side.
Tossed up outside off, Elgar gets well forward and smothers it.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot to the covers.
FOUR! Streaky runs! Floated outside off, extra bounce as Elgar goes for the cut. Gets a thickish edge that runs away wide of backward point to get a boundary at third man.
A bit short outside off, pushed off the back foot to the covers.
Good length angled away outside off, another leave from JPD.
Duminy signals for a change of bat.
Full and outside off, Duminy drives it well off the front foot. Mid off goes across to his right to make the stop.
Fuller outside off, JP doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Full and tailing in on middle stump, Duminy shuffles across and jams it to mid on.
Back of a length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball around off, JP looks to push at it but gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Loopy and around off, Elgar presses forward and jabs it to point.
Flighted outside off, Duminy gets forward and pushes it towards point for a single.
Sliding in from outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Drifting in from outside off, JP blocks it well from the crease.
Flighted outside off, defended well off the front foot.

FOUR! Poor ball to start the spell! Drops it a bit short outside off, Duminy sits back and cuts it away to the deep point fence for a boundary. He won't spare any loose ball especially when in this mood. Inches closer to a special ton.
Nathan Lyon is finally brought into the attack now!
Full and outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball angled away outside off, Elgar got squared up a touch as he looked to block from the crease.
Dug in short around off, Duminy drags the pull to deep mid-wicket for a single. LEAD IS NOW 200.
Good length outside off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.

FOUR! Does it again! The Aussies don't know what's hit them! Another length ball, again it's outside off, once again Duminy drives it in terrific style on the up through the covers for a boundary. Repetitive isn't it? Certainly not boring though the way he is timing them. Class stuff!
150-run stand between Duminy and Elgar!
FOUR! Duminy is on a roll! Length ball outside off, another spectacular on-the-up drive through the covers. Superb timing and another boundary to JP. He is simply unstoppable at the moment.
Fullish and tailing into the pads, worked behind square leg for a single.
Fuller on leg stump, Duminy misses the flick and is rapped on the pads.
Length ball well down the leg side, Duminy misses the flick.
FOUR! Shot! His drives have been impeccable today! Length ball outside off, JP leans into it and drives it excellently on the up through the covers to find the fence. Top stroke!
FOUR! Creamed! Full and wide outside off, Duminy reaches out and thumps it through the covers. Timed it so well that it sped across the turf to the fence.
Full and on the pads, worked away through mid-wicket for a single.

Welcome back for the second session. Australia need a special spell from somebody to stay alive in the match or else the Proteas will hammer them out of the game with a huge lead. The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. Mitchell Starc to start proceedings after lunch.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 2.....

Australia's bowlers got some response off the track but were mostly inconsistent in their lines and lengths thereby nullifying the threats. The last 15-20 minutes before lunch saw the bowlers being more accurate and there was a drastic difference. The lead is now 181 and the sooner Australia's bowlers learn, the better as otherwise, it could be over for the hosts. Join us in a while for the second session.

A superb session for South Africa as the tourists continued to strengthen their grip around the Test match. Elgar and Duminy continued to chug along undefeated without any major trouble. The duo thwarted everything the Australians threw at them, thereby getting past their fifties as well. The odd ball has misbehaved a bit but the batsmen haven't been affected much.
In the channel outside off, JP Duminy lifts his bat and lets it go through to the keeper. THAT SHALL BE LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Angles it on middle, Duminy gets across to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. An appeal is made but the umpire is not interested. Replays show it was going over the stumps.
Digs it short and down the leg side, Duminy moves inside the line and lets it go.
Comes on the front foot and defends it solidly back to the bowler.
Fuller in length and outside off, Duminy presses forward and keeps it out.
Back of a length delivery outside off, JP lifts his bat and lets it go.
Keeps it full on the pads, the SA opener works it straight to short mid-wicket.
Around middle and off, Dean Elgar offers a solid front foot defense.
Fractionally short on leg, Duminy swipes it through backward square leg for a single.
Good shot but straight to Warner! Fuller in length and little bit of width on offer too. Duminy leans into it and drives it but it goes straight to Warner at mid off.
Length ball, angling in, Duminy is squared up a bit as the ball goes off the outside part of the bat towards gully.
Fuller in length and curling back in, Duminy digs it out.
On a good length and outside off, Elgar defends it gently to the off side.
Back of a length ball on off, Elgar swivels and goes for the pull but fails to put bat on ball.
Prods forward and keeps it out in time.
Another slip comes in place now...
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Ohh, that took off! Hazlewood hurls it on a length on off, it rises off the deck. Elgar looks to defend but is beaten all ends up by the extra bounce there.
On a length and outside off, Elgar plays it inside the line and lets it go.
Excellent stop! Fuller in length and on middle, Duminy bunts it back to the bowler who does well to stop it in his followthrough.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller and on the pads, Duminy looks to play it straight but closes the face of the bat to early and ends up chipping it back to the bowler.

FOUR! That's played with reasonably soft hands! Very impressive! Siddle bowls it on a length outside off, Duminy just tries to use the pace as he keeps the face of the bat open and gently glides it between gully and second slip for a boundary to third man.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Dean tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Good length ball on middle, tucked towards the leg side for a single.
Peter Siddle comes in for another burst before lunch.

Touch short and outside off, Duminy stays in the crease and pushes it through backward point. Mitchell Marsh and Lyon gives it a chase. The latter gets to the ball and then scoops it to Marsh who returns the throw to the keeper. But the batsmen run three till then.
Slips it down the leg side, JP goes for the flick but misses.

Josh hurls it on a length on off, Duminy looks to defend it off the front foot but gets an inside edge on the pads. Hazlewood appeals for an LBW but the umpire says not out. Smith from slips confers his bowler and then decides not to go for the review. Replays show that it was a good call as there was a big inside edge there.
Good length ball on off, it hits one of the cracks there and shoots. Duminy comes forward to defend but is surprised by the extra bounce as the ball hits the handle of the bat to the off side.
Length ball just outside off, Duminy looks to defend it with soft hands but gets a bottom edge which goes over the stumps. Nevill comes forward and collects it on the bounce.
Good length delivery on off, Duminy lifts his bat and lets it go through to the keeper.
Josh Hazlewood is back on!
Angles it on the pads, Elgar tucks it towards the leg side for nothing.
Much better! Fuller in length and outside off, Elgar defends it from within the crease.
FOUR BYES! Horrendous from Starc! Fuller and down the leg side, wrong line from Mitchell. Elgar leaves it alone and the keeper could do nothing about it as the ball sped to the fine leg fence.
Duminy taps it towards covers for a single.
Gets across and works it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and spraying it down the leg side, Duminy initially tries to flick it but then decides it's better if he leaves it alone.
Gets behind the line and defends it nicely as the ball rolls past the non-striker towards mid on.
Banged in short on middle, Elgar sits underneath that one.
Elgar comes on the front foot and drives it back to the bowler.
Fuller and angling in, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Very full on off, Elgar pushes it towards covers where Khawaja dives to his left and stops it.
Fuller in length and outside off, DE makes an easy leave to the keeper.
Fuller and tailing back in sharply. Duminy misses his flick and is hit on the pads. A stifled appeal is made but it was missing leg for sure.
Touch short on middle, JP plays a controlled pull shot but finds short mid-wicket.
On a length and angling in, Duminy gets back and defends it towards the leg side.
Fuller in length and around off, Duminy presses forward and drives it past covers. Warner gives it a chase and keeps them down to a couple.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Length ball on off, punched through covers for a brace.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls a low full toss on middle and off. Elgar flicks it towards short mid-wicket where Voges dives to his right to stop that one. Brilliant fielding!
Lovely ball! This time bowls a yorker on the stumps, Dean digs it out in time.

A loud, loud shout for lbw! Marsh bowls it on a length and gets it to curl back in sharply with some bounce as well. Elgar looks to flick it across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. Marsh turns back to appeal and keeps on appealing but the umpire turns it down. Replays show he was hit over the pads and height was clearly the issue. Good that they didn't opt for the review.
A harmless ball outside off, Dean has got nothing to offer on that one.
Fuller in length and hurled outside off, Elgar shoulders his arms to that one.
Angles it on the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side for one.
Good length ball, angling in, Elgar comes forward and defends it towards the leg side.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Dean drops his wrists down and lets it through.
A length ball on middle and leg, tucked through mid-wicket for a couple.

Lovely delivery! Starc pitches it right up there, tailing back in a touch. Elgar just about digs it out in time as the ball rolls past the stumps. Had he been touch late to do so, he would have been gone.
Two slips in place now...

Play and a miss! Starc fires a length ball outside off, Elgar prods forward to poke at it but the extra bounce off the deck gets the better of him as the ball just about kisses the outside edge to the keeper.
Back of a length ball on middle, Duminy plays a controlled pull shot through square leg for a single.
Mitchell Starc is called back into the attack!
Angles it on middle, tucked towards the leg side.
Fuller in length and around off, pushed off the front foot towards covers.

FOUR LEG BYES! Surprised Elgar was not even bothered where the ball is heading towards. Marsh bowls a length ball on middle, moving away a touch. Elgar looks to flick but misses as the ball goes off the back leg and flies past a diving Smith at first slip for a boundary. I thought there was a nick but replays confirmed there isn't any.
In the channel outside off, Elgar lifts his bat and allows it to go through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, it's left alone.
Wide! Horror delivery! Too full and too wide outside off. It's outside the pitch and umpire Nigel Llong rightly calls it a wide.
Serves on a length and wide outside off to trouble Dean Elgar.
Touch fuller in length and angling in again, Duminy gets forward and keeps it out.
Good length ball, angling in. JPD covers the line and offers a straight bat in defense.
On a length and just around off, Duminy stays in the crease and taps it towards covers.
Touch full and around off, JP prods forward and defends it gently.
FOUR! Easy as it looks! Siddle sprays this one on the pads and was asking for trouble. Duminy shuffles a bit and works it off his hips down to fine leg for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Duminy hangs back and defends it towards covers.
Drinks break. SA's hour comfortably as both the overnight batsmen have continued to coast along. Lead is 149 now, Australia surely feeling the heat.
Spears it well down the leg side, no shot offered to that one.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Beaten! Full and just around off, Elgar is lured into the false shot and is beaten.
Length ball around leg stump, JP gets across and clips it through backward square leg for a single.
Pitched up around off, Elgar gets forward and pushes it to the covers.
Good length down the leg side, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball outside off, Elgar gets across and jabs it to short mid-wicket.

FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Back of a length down the leg side, Elgar gets across and helps it on its way towards the long leg fence. The fielder at fine leg goes across to his right to make a pretentious dive which is in vain.
Fuller on middle and off, Elgar pushes it firmly back to the bowler.
Good length outside off, steered towards point with soft hands.
Fuller around off, Elgar gets across and defends it to the leg side.
Full and outside off, angling away, Duminy lets it pass.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Back of a length on leg stump, Elgar clips it behind square for a single.
Good length outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot.
100-run stand between Elgar and Duminy!

He's safe as expected! Full and outside off, JP drives it firmly towards mid off and goes for a quick single. Warner fires a direct hit at the bowler's end and it's referred upstairs. JPD was well in.
Appeal for a run out at the bowler's end. Duminy seems to be fine but let's see.
Length ball closer to off, no stroke offered to that one.
Back of a length angling away outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Full and outside off, Elgar defends it well off the front foot.
Good length angling away outside off, blocked from the crease to mid off.
Full and outside off, Elgar gets on the front foot and blocks.
Full and outside off, Elgar leans forward and pushes it to mid off.
Length ball on middle and leg, kept a touch low as Duminy jabs it to mid-wicket.
Full and around off, Duminy gets forward and blocks it.
Beauty! Full and around off, nips away late as Duminy is beaten on the drive. Almost the perfect length and Marsh would want to be in that area more often than not.
Good length angled away wider outside off, JP doesn't offer a stroke.
Full and outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball outside off, JP doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Good length outside off, Duminy gets back and blocks it to the off side.
Full and outside off, pushed off the front foot towards point.
Double change as Mitchell Marsh is coming on to bowl from the other end.
Good length angled away outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Full and on leg stump, Elgar gets across and jams it to mid on.
Fullish on middle and off, gets forward and blocks it.
Edged....doesn't carry! Length ball angling away from outside off, Elgar pushes at it with soft hands but gets the outside edge. Falls short of Smith at first slip.
Full and on the pads, Elgar gets across and clips it to the leg side.
FOUR! Loosener from Siddle to start and it's punished. Fullish and on the pads, Elgar gets across and flicks it away sweetly through square leg. Timed it well and that sped away to the fence.
Peter Siddle comes on to bowl.
8th Test fifty for JP Duminy!

FOUR! What a shot! Wow! That is some response from JP. This is fuller on middle, Duminy gets across and drives it dead straight past the bowler. Timed superbly as it goes down the ground to the fence.
Good length on middle, shapes away after hitting that crack in the center of the deck. Duminy plays inside the line.
Length ball on middle stump, JP shuffles and defends it towards cover.
Pitched up outside off, JP drives it firmly towards mid off.
Fuller on leg stump, Elgar gets across and whips it to mid-wicket.
Good length on middle and leg, Elgar nudges it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Full and straying on the pads, Elgar flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, pushed off the back foot to extra cover for a single.
Length ball on leg stump, Elgar gets across to flick but the ball rolls off the pads to fine leg. They take a leg bye.
Full but way outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Good length on leg stump, tucked towards square leg.
Back of a length outside off, extra bounce as Elgar is beaten on the poke. He tried to withdraw his bat but couldn't avoid it.
Length ball on middle and off, JP gets across and blocks it to the leg side.
Full and outside off, Duminy drives it towards the covers.
Back of a length down the leg side, left alone to the keeper.
FOUR! Flashy but safe! Full and angling away from outside off, Duminy chases it with a loose drive sans any footwork. The slice flies past a diving Mitchell Marsh at gully to the ropes.
Fuller on off, Duminy gets across and drills it back to the bowler.
Good length on off, angling away as Duminy stands tall to defend.
Full and on leg stump, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Very full outside off, Duminy digs it out towards mid off.
Good length outside off, JP stays in the crease and taps it to point.
Another full ball on middle stump, Elgar shuffles across and wrists it through mid-wicket to the deep. Three more to the total.
4th Test fifty for Dean Elgar!

FOUR! Clipped away! Full and on middle and leg, Elgar gets across to that one and tucks it through square leg. Timed it well as that raced away to the fence for a boundary. It's been a fine knock from the opener.
Five wides! Bonus runs! Banged in short outside off by Starc but it's too high and it sails comfortably over a leaping Nevill to the fence.
Length ball outside off, Elgar gets forward and taps it to point.
Good length angling away from outside off, JP makes a good leave.
Full outside off, JP gets forward and lifts his bat to let it pass.
Good length around leg stump, Elgar looks to flick but it goes off the pads down to fine leg. They get a leg bye.
Peach of a delivery! Back of a length around off, Elgar looks to push from the crease but is beaten all ends up. Extra bounce off the deck and away movement as well to whiz past the edge.
Good length angled away outside off, Elgar stand stall and taps it to the off side.
Full and outside off, blocked well off the front foot.

FOUR! Shot! Duminy's timing continues to be fab. Full ball outside off, he just gets the stride in and caresses it through the covers for a boundary. The partnership is flourishing and the lead is now 112.
Good length outside off, Dean shoulders arms to that one.
FOUR! Top shot! Very full on middle, a bit of tail into Duminy who adjusts well to drive it superbly past mid on to find the fence. It was a good ball but equally well played.
Full and a hint of inswing from around off, Elgar drives well towards mid off where Warner makes a diving stop to his left. Keeps the batsmen down to just a single.
Full and just around off, Elgar gets forward and pushes it towards mid off.
Fuller around off, Elgar plays around his front pad and jams it to mid on.
Full and around off, JP pushes at it with soft hands as the edge goes on the bounce to gully. Mitchell Marsh makes a decent stop.
Length ball angled away around off, no shot offered to that one.
Fullish and outside off, Elgar eases it to short cover where Shaun Marsh fumbles and parries it. Warner at mid off goes across to his right to make a sliding stop. Single taken. First run of the day.
Good length closer to off, Hazlewood's line is just a touch too wide to make Elgar play at the moment.
Length ball slanting away wider outside off, Elgar makes another easy leave.
Good length angling away from well outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.
Back of a length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length just around off, defended well off the front foot towards short cover.
Full and outside off, blocked off the front foot towards point.
Length ball sprayed wide outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fullish and around off, Duminy drives it firmly to mid off.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.

It seems like a fairly good day in prospect as far as the weather is concerned. The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. Huge first session coming up in the context of the game. Dean Elgar and JP Duminy to resume their stand. Mitchell Starc to start proceedings on day 3.

Australia need to bowl with same intent which they had in the first innings. If they manage to pick up a few early wickets, they could well be back in the game. The first two sessions today will give us an idea which way the tides are turning. Will we see the Proteas swelling the lead to a big one? Or will the home side restrict them to a chaseable total? Stay tuned as they action is not that far away...

Hello and a warm welcome for day 3 of this exciting Test match. A roaring comeback from the Proteas yesterday saw them having a grip back in this game. After bundling out the Aussies, they didn't get the start they would have liked but Dean Elgar and JP Duminy came to the fore and saw off the day. The good thing for the visitors is that they have already taken the lead past 100 and it would be interesting to see how they go about with their plans today.
...DAY 3, SESSION 1...

The Australian bowlers were good only in patches and lacked the discipline which they had showed in the first innings. They sprayed the new ball around and some of the tactics after Amla's dismissal were debatable, especially the short ball ploys. The lead is now 102 but this game is still very much open. Remember, South Africa are a bowler short now as well and so they need to bat really well to compensate for it. Tomorrow should be another cracking day. Tune in at 0800 IST for the third day's play. Till then, goodbye and take care.

South Africa started well in their second innings, in stark contrast to yesterday morning. Elgar looked confident and although Cook was nervy, the pair had started well before the latter departed to a blinder by Shaun Marsh. Amla failed once again but Duminy launched a counterattack and along with Elgar, saw the tourists to stumps without further damage. The lead too has gone past the 100-run mark.

If day one was dominated by Australia, it's fair to say the visitors have roared back in style on the second day and have their noses slightly in front at this point of time. Who would have thought that yesterday or even today with Australia 158/0 at one point? The Proteas produced an incredible comeback to restrict the Australians to just 244, which meant a very slender 2-run lead. This was done despite losing Steyn midway through the morning session.
Flighted off spinner on middle, from over the wicket, Elgar defends it off his front foot to the off side. That will be STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Too full in length on middle, Dean gets forward and eases it to mid on.
Leans on the front foot and pushes it with the spin to silly point. On one bounce to the fielder.
Strides forward to a full ball and jams it down.
Tossed up ball on off, Dean is on the front foot as he defends it past the left outstretched hand of silly point.
A silly point comes in.
Flighted full ball on off, Elgar gets on the front foot in defense.
Final over of the day...
Beauty! Marsh angles across a length ball on off, nipping away, Duminy is caught guessing inside the line as he misses the ball completely.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Digs in a short ball to force the batsman deep inside the crease, JP ducks.
A touch short and around off, Dean turns it wide of mid on and crosses for a single.
Gets back inside the crease and helps it to mid-wicket.
BREAKING NEWS - Dale Steyn has been ruled out of the series due to the bone fracture in his shoulder. Big blow for the Proteas when they'll come out to bowl.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Five wides! Marsh digs in a short ball which goes well over the batsman and a leaping keeper for a boundary. Good attempt but fails to get the execution right.
Rocks back and punches it through the line, fails to beat covers.
Flatter and quicker on off, defended from the crease.
Loopy one on off, it's pushed off the front foot to mid off.
Tossed up ball on off, Duminy punches it solidly to the off side, finds the fielder.
Duminy has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shortish and on off, Elgar goes back and cuts it late through backward point for a single.
Some extra bounce there as Duminy tries to defend it by getting forward. The extra lift takes the deflection and hits him on the helmet.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Kagiso Rabada is padded up. Maybe, he will come in next as a nightwatchman if a wicket falls.
Fuller and outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.
On a good length and around off, a back foot defense by JP.
A touch short and angling away from the batsman, Duminy punches it from the back foot to point where the fielder tumbles and stops the ball.
Back of a length ball angling down the leg side, Elgar nudges it down to fine leg for a single.
Mitchell Marsh is reinserted into the attack as well.
Flighted and on off, worked past short mid-wicket and wide of mid on for a run.
Floated ball, but too full, Duminy strokes it past the diving short extra cover but it fails to beat the diving Warner from mid off. A single taken. 50-run stand comes up.
Lunges and defends it watchfully to the off side.
Advances down the track and brings his bat and pad together in defense. A stifled appeal from the bowler but it has come off the inside edge.
Too full in length and around leg, Duminy brings a straight bat in defense.
Flighted and around off, from around the wicket, Duminy gets forward and defends it back.
Nathan Lyon to have another go before stumps, replaces Siddle in the attack.
On a full length and around middle and leg, Dean works it to mid-wicket and sends his partner back who was looking for a run.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Fractionally short and around middle, Elgar goes on his toes and defends it on the leg side. Khawaja collects it on one bounce and gestures to back flick it towards the stumps.
Bouncer around leg, Dean ducks.
Better line, a touch short and on middle and off, Elgar jumps on the back foot and defends it down safely.
Back of a length delivery down the leg side, sharp in pace, Elgar pushes at it and misses.
Going down the leg side, on a length, Duminy fails to flick and it goes off his pads to square leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Switches to over the wicket and bowls a full length ball on off, Duminy drives it to mid off.
Good length ball on off, JP gets back inside the crease and defends it to the off side.
Presses forward and pushes it in the gap at covers, finds the gap and pinches a single as Khawaja charges to the ball.
Runs in from around the wicket and bowls a full ball around off, Elgar defends it towards mid off.
Slight hold up in play. Dean Elgar gets a new arm-guard and a bit of magic spray also applied by the physio. Seems he is still feeling the pain.
Dug in short on leg stump, Duminy nails the pull and the ball crashes into Khawaja at short leg.
Shortish on middle, Duminy stands tall and blocks it to short leg.

FOUR! Smashed! Top stroke this from Duminy! Shortish on leg stump, he swivels and controls the swat pull towards the deep backward square leg fence for a boundary. His counterattack has certainly caught Australia off-guard.

The plan almost worked! Shortish around leg stump, Elgar gets across to work it away but the bounce gets a bit big on him. The ball just falls short of a diving Warner at leg gully and scoots down to fine leg. Single taken.
Another bouncer but the line isn't troubling Elgar at the moment. He ducks easily.
Banged in short on leg stump, Elgar ducks under it.
Fuller on leg stump, Duminy gets across and drives it towards mid on.
Good length on middle stump, JP gets across and jabs it to mid-wicket.
Good length angled away just outside off, no shot offered to that one.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, Duminy drives it through covers for three runs.
FOUR! Siddle bowls a leg stump delivery, Duminy picks it up and eases it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Dishes out yet another short ball, down the leg side, Elgar watches the line closely and allows it through to the keeper.
Fractionally short on leg, it's pulled down to fine leg for one.
Well played. Starc targets the rib cage with a short delivery, Elgar turns and eases it wide of leg gully for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, sharp pace, Elgar gets hurried up a bit and defends it to the leg side.
Hurls across a length delivery in the channel outside off, from around the wicket, Elgar leaves it alone.
As expected the first ball is a short one, Duminy does well to keep his hook shot down the ground and takes a single as the ball travels to deep square leg.
Change of ends for Mitchell Starc. A short leg and leg gully in place. A third man in place as well. The field is set for short pitch bowling.
Pitches it full and on off, Dean forces it down the ground and Starc dives to his right from mid on to stop the ball.
Shortish and on off, Elgar fetches it from there and tries to flick it through mid-wicket. But he fails to middle it and ends up mistiming it somewhere to the left of the bowler.
This one is bowled on the driving length outside off, Elgar shows a lot patience as he leaves it alone.
A touch short in length and on off, Elgar punches it from the back foot to covers.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Full and on off, Elgar has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Peter Siddle is back on.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
FOUR! Quality shot! Hazlewood bowls it on a length and outside off, Duminy reaches out for it and strokes it right from the meat of the bat through extra cover. A touch of class on that shot by JP!
A bit too straight this time, Duminy works it on the leg side towards square leg.
Length ball outside off, Duminy covers the line and allows it through.
A touch short on middle and leg, Elgar tucks it behind square leg and pinches a single.
Lands it full and outside off, Elgar drives it off his front foot but straight to short cover.
The physio is out there to attend to Elgar who is having a sore elbow. DRINKS HAVE BEEN TAKEN.

Good length outside off, Duminy pushes at it but gets an outside edge that goes just on the bounce to the Smith in the slip cordon. It's hit him flush on the finger and he seems to be in a bit of discomfort.
Back of a length outside off, Duminy gets back to that one and blocks it.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Banged in pacy bumper on leg stump, Elgar is tucked up as he looks to fend awkwardly at it. The ball flies off the wrist down to fine leg. They take a leg bye.
Full and wide outside off, Elgar reaches out to push it through the covers for a brace.
Full and well down the leg side, Elgar fails to connect the flick.
Banged in short around off, well-directed as Duminy arches his back to sway away.
Dug in short on middle, JP ducks to avoid the bumper.
Another length ball outside off, Duminy shoulders arms to make a leave.
Good length around off, Duminy gets back and jabs it to point.
Length ball outside off, Duminy doesn't offer a shot to that one.
FOUR! Fine shot! Duminy is looking in good touch! Full and just outside off, he gets forward and drives it elegantly down the ground through mid off to find the fence.
Yet another full ball outside off, Elgar leans forward and pushes it to mid off.
Full and wide outside off, Dean squeezes it towards gully
Full and around off, tailing in a touch as Elgar pushes it to mid off.
Fuller length well outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fullish and outside off, Elgar drives firmly towards extra cover.
Fuller and well outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Mitchell Starc comes back on for another spell.
FOUR! Another lovely drive from JP! Full ball outside off, he gets the stride forward and caresses it through the covers to pick up a boundary. Good positive batting.
Lovely ball! On a length angling away outside off, Duminy pushes at it without any footwork and is lucky not to get an edge.
Shortish on leg stump, Elgar tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
Good length around off, Elgar gets forward and blocks it.
Fuller on middle, Duminy works it to mid-wicket. Single taken.
Back of a length around off, Duminy stays back and taps it to point.
Full and outside off, Elgar gets forward and blocks it.
Flatter on off, punched off the back foot to mid-wicket.

SIX! Fine shot! Tossed up around off, Elgar is down the pitch in a jiffy and lofts it down the ground over long on for a maximum. Elgar continues to take his chances against the off-spinner. He has to be a touch careful though with the ball turning away.
Sliding in from outside off, Elgar gets forward and defends it solidly.
Fuller on middle, Elgar gets forward and blocks it.
Floated outside off, Elgar goes back and jabs it to point.
Length ball outside off, Duminy gets a thick inside edge on to the pads.
Another bumper and once again Duminy lets it pass.
Short ball and Duminy ducks quickly under it.
Fuller outside off, Duminy drives it well but straight to short cover.
Good length outside off, Duminy steers it towards point.
Back of a length outside off, Duminy lets it pass to the keeper.
Flighted outside off, Elgar doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Fuller outside off, Elgar defends it well off the front foot.
Drifting away outside off, Elgar gets forward and defends it.
Tossed up outside off, Duminy leans into it and drives it through the covers. Three runs picked up as Marsh chases to pull it back just in time.
Drifting away from outside off, blocked well off the front foot to the covers.
Full on middle and off, Elgar works it towards wide mid on for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful shot to get off the mark. Full and outside off, JPD leans into it and creams it through the covers to find the fence. Footwork was the key on the shot.
Good length outside off, Duminy gets back and jabs it to point.
Short ball and Duminy ducks under the bumper.
Fuller and outside off, Duminy gets forward and blocks it.
Full on middle and off, Duminy looks to block as the ball rolls off the outer half to the off side.
JP Duminy walks out to bat.

OUT! Got him! Twin failures for Amla. Length ball around off, nips in sharply as Amla plays back to that one. He is late on it and is beaten by the movement as the ball crashes into the sticks. Hazlewood is pumped up and so are the rest of the Aussies. They know how big this wicket is. SA lead by 43. Suddenly the hosts seem to have found some kind of momentum after a dry spell with the new ball.
Fuller outside off, Elgar presses forward and blocks it.

FOUR! Almost a chance! Elgar is clearly targeting Lyon. Tossed up ball outside off, he charges down the track and bludgeons it uppishly past the bowler to the long off fence for a boundary. Would have been a blinder had he got his hands to take it.
Fuller on off, Elgar gets across and works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Drifting in on middle, works it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Amla flicks it but straight to short mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, Amla gets the stride in and defends it solidly.
Good length on off, Elgar gets right behind the line and blocks watchfully.
Full and slanting away from outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length angled away just outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Length ball on middle stump, Elgar gets across and blocks it.
Fuller outside off, Elgar gets on the front foot and taps it to the off side.
Full and outside off, Elgar gets forward and blocks it to cover-point.
Josh Hazlewood is back on for another spell.
Flighted outside off, Amla gets on the front foot and blocks it out.
Fuller on middle, Elgar drives it to mid on for a single.
Drifting away from outside off, another leave by Elgar.
Floated outside off, Elgar doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Mistimed shot falls safe! Drifting in from just outside off, Elgar steps out to loft it down the ground against the spin. Miscues it over mid on and gets a brace.
Floated around off, Elgar looks to block but gets an inside edge to the leg side.
Fullish and on off, Amla gets across and drives it back to the bowler.
Full length on middle and leg, Amla gets across and blocks it out.
Hashim Amla is the new man in.

OUT! Siddle draws first blood! Short and around off, Cook goes for the pull but cannot keep the shot down. The ball flies to short mid-wicket where Shaun Marsh dives to his left to take a brilliant catch. He took a superb one in the first innings as well and has got the Aussies a much-needed wicket.
Dug in short around off, Nevill leaps to take it well.
Good length angled in on off, blocked solidly from the crease to mid-wicket.
Full and around off, Cook defends it well from the crease.
Drifting away outside off, Elgar reaches out and pushes it towards point.
Tossed up around off, Elgar gets the stride in and defends it well.
Fuller on middle and leg, dug out towards mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, Elgar does not offer a shot to that one.
FOUR! Good shot! Floated around off, Elgar charges down the track and lofts it straight past the bowler. The umpire had to take evasive action as the ball rocketed to the fence for a boundary.
Flighted outside off, blocked off the front foot towards the covers.
Full and angled in from outside off, Cook presses forward and blocks it towards mid off.
Full and outside off, Cook presses forward and defends it well.
Full and on middle, Elgar gets across and tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to the covers for a single.
Full and curving in from around off, Cook pushes at as the ball goes off the inside half to mid-wicket.
Drinks break.
Loopy and outside off, left alone to end the over.
Flighted and landing just outside off, not turning much, Dean offers no shot and lets it through. Not very far away from the off stump.
Drags his length short on off, Elgar goes back and cuts it to point where the fielder makes a diving stop.
Nicely lets out a tossed up ball on off, fuller in length, DE defends it off his front foot.
Flighted and on off, a little bit of drift, Dean defends it off his front foot.
Tossed up ball on off, Elgar defends it off his back foot to point.
Nathan Lyon is brought into the attack. South Africa lead by 27 runs.
Full and on off, Stephen defends it solidly from the back foot.
Angles in a fuller length ball on off, Cook pushes it off his front foot to covers, looks for a run but it has gone straight to the fielder and the batsmen stop in their tracks.
On a length and outside off, shaping away a bit, Cook leaves it for Nevill.
Serves it on a length and just around off, Stephen gets across and shoulders arms.
Full in length and outside off, Cook plays inside the line and it goes off the outside half of the bat to gully. Mitchell Marsh with a tumbling stop this time.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

A good delivery. On a length and just around off, maybe straightening a bit, Dean gets squared up in defense and keeps it out off the outside half of the bat. Straight to Starc at gully who stops it with a needless tumble.
Half-volley outside off, Elgar pushes it off his front foot, good timing but it finds the short cover fielder.
Length ball angling into the batsman, Dean gets forward and pushes it towards point.
Marsh switches to around the wicket and pitches a full ball outside off, Elgar has an easy leave.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Shot! Marsh goes short with his length, around off and bowled with a gentle pace, Elgar rocks back and pulls it nicely over mid-wicket and mid on for a boundary.
Angles in a good length ball on off, making the batsman play this time, Cook gets behind the line and defends it to the leg side. An over very easily negotiated by Stephen.
Hint of away swing, on a length and outside off, SC gets across the stumps and shoulders arms.
Good leave. On a length and just outside off, Cook covers the line and movement before leaving it alone for the keeper.
Lands it full and on off, Cook gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Full and angling into the batsman, Stephen goes deep inside the crease and defends it down safely.
Back of a length ball on off, Cook goes on his toes and defends it to the off side.
Bouncer and on off, Elgar ducks to end the over. Not a threatening one but a maiden.
On a length around off, some extra bounce, Elgar defends it from the crease with a loose bottom hand.
Too full in length on off, Elgar once again pushes it off his front foot to short cover.
Fullish and angling in, Elgar gets forward and pushes it straight to short cover.
Good length ball outside off, Elgar goes back and defends it to the off side. Straightaway screams "wait" as his partner was interested in a run.
Lets out a grunt and bowls a 127 kph length delivery outside off, Elgar has an easy leave.
Double bowling change. Mitchell Marsh replaces Hazlewood in the attack.
On a length and outside off, holding its line, Cook goes back to cover the line and then leaves it. A decent first over by Siddle!
Full in length and angling into the batsman, Cook lunges and defends it solidly.
Good length ball around off, angling in a touch, Stephen gets across the stumps and shoulders arms.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Sharp single although there was a risk element involved. Full and around off, Elgar pushes it with soft hands past his partner at the other end and calls Cook through for a single. Warner moves across to his left, picks up the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but fails to connect.
Bang on target first ball, on a length and around middle and off, Dean gets squared up a bit and defends it to the off side.
Peter Siddle replaces Starc in the attack.
Poorly directed bouncer, down the leg side, an easy leave for the striker.
Hazlewood digs in a short ball on off, Cook ducks underneath it.
Angles in a full ball on off, it's defended off the front foot by Stephen.

FOUR! A fractionally over-pitched delivery on off, SC gets on the front foot and drives it superbly through extra cover. It comes from the middle of the bat and just races through to the fence, beating the chase put in by Warner.
Play and a miss! Good length delivery in the channel outside off, holding its line, Cook has a needless poke inside the line and misses.
Full and angling into the batsman, Cook plays it from the back foot to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Angles across a good length ball outside off, Cook goes on his toes and runs it down through the gap at gully for three runs. Mitchell Marsh did the chasing job.
Full in length on off, a hint of inward shape, Cook sticks back inside the crease and defends it off the inside half of the bat.
Lands it full and outside off, Cook pushes it with an angled bat to covers.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Sharp delivery by Starc, keeps it very full around off, 144.5 kph, swinging back in a shade, Elgar digs it out safely.
Dean Elgar facing Mitchell Starc for the first time in this innings...
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

Four leg byes! Extra bounce from a length around middle and leg, Cook gets into an awkward position as he tries to keep it out. Fails to do so and it screams away after taking his thigh pad. The fielder in the deep tries his best but fails to keep it inside the line.
Goes on the back foot and taps it down in the gap at covers for a brisk single.
Switches to over the wicket and hurls across a back of a length ball outside off, Cook gets across the stumps and shoulders arms.
Fullish and outside off, Elgar pushes it to covers for a single.
Hazlewood continues from around the wicket and bowls it on a good length outside off, Elgar allows it through.

Huge shout for a catch! Starc hurls across a very full length ball outside off, going on with the left-armer's angle, Cook pushes inside the line, a bit tentatively and misses. The keeper collects the ball and they all go up in a big appeal. Nothing from the umpire. The replays detect nothing.
Another back foot defense by Cook. Not looking at ease at the moment against the sharp pace of Starc.
On a length around middle, Cook gets behind the line and defends it watchfully on the leg side.
Good length ball on off, Cook once again hops inside the crease and defends it to the off side.
Starc bowls a tempting line, full and just outside off, angling away, there to be driven, Cook sticks back and shoulders arms.
Back of a length ball on off, Cook jumps on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
Serves it full and on off, Elgar is drawn forward as he pushes it towards mid off.
Operating in good lines, Josh. Hurls a length ball just outside off, Elgar covers the line and shoulders arms.
This one is wide outside off, Elgar has an easy leave.
Good line, lands it on a length just outside off, Elgar initially looks to push inside the line but then withdraws his bat at the last moment. Got out doing the same in the first innings.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
FOUR! Superb shot! Hazlewood drops it full and outside off, Elgar leans forward and drives it crisply through covers for a boundary.
Oversteps and bowls a no ball. It's outside off and left alone by Dean.

FOUR! Nicely played! Starc angles across a length ball outside off, Cook stays inside the crease, opens the face of the bat and pushes it at the last moment through the gap between slips and gully for a boundary. Must be "feeling at home" now after getting off the mark in this Test. Scored a naught in the first innings.
Bowls it full and angling away from the batsman, a little too wide to make the batsman play.
Pitches it too full outside off, Cook plays it from the crease to mid off.
Finally gets his line right and beats the bat. Hurls across a length ball on off, angling away, Cook sticks to his crease, pushes inside the line and misses.
Another wayward delivery, short and way wide outside off, an easy leave for Stephen. At the moment, Starc is struggling to get his radar right!
Wrong line, on a length and down the leg side, Cook gets across the stumps, tries to flick but misses. Nearly gets an inside edge.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Leans forward to a full ball and jams it out through covers for a couple of runs.
Length ball on off, Elgar gets across the stumps and defends it to the leg side.
Pitches it full and outside off, it's driven off the front foot to mid off.
Good length ball on off, turned off the pads to mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off, it's left alone by Dean.
Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.
Full and down the leg side, Cook fails to flick it.
Fuller length outside off, Cook squeezes it towards third man.
Outside off, left alone.
Bowls one on the pads, swings down, Cook does not go after it.
This is bowled right outside off, left alone.
This is hurled down the leg side, Cook lets it go through.
